body: 2026-10-03, 02:25 to 02:55: owner feedback after the manual pass, and the follow-up fixes.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Owner feedback.**U+000AU+002D (a) The Mac app opens too small, and the flower overlaps the titles. The owner asked for a 1200x800 opening size (decision 01M40EZEBBY9E7VTNM5NN2GY78).U+000AU+002D (b) The owner took the note-step toast for a reminder and asked why the clean Android install never asked for notification permission.U+000A  U+002D That is correct behaviour. The Note 10+ runs Android 12, which has no POST_NOTIFICATIONS prompt, and both test apps hold the POST_NOTIFICATION app-op at its default, allow.U+000A  U+002D Samsung's `allowNoti=false` in dumpsys notification reads false for all 99 apps, Gmail included, so it is not a block flag.U+000A  U+002D On the Mac, the log shows the fresh app asked at 02:19:09 and was allowed at 02:19:12. The owner confirmed the macOS prompt appeared.U+000AU+002D (c) Meadow speed on the Note 10+ is acceptable for now, pending an S24 Ultra test (decision 01M40EZJ8ED2QCVNCDHK56BQYC).U+000AU+002D (d) New defect: the Meadow month focus pill's month name and bloom count sit high, on macOS and Android.U+000A  U+002D Cause: in meadow_focus_stepper.dart, a Column with mainAxisSize.min sits inside a SizedBox with a fixed height. The tight height makes it full height, and children start at the top.U+000AU+002D (e) The owner did not follow the status bar finding, so screenshots were sent. They are under docs/specs/screens/ (git-ignored):U+000A  U+002D statusbar-light-theme-emulator.pngU+000A  U+002D statusbar-dark-theme-note10.pngU+000A  U+002D onboarding-note-toast-emulator.pngU+000A  U+002D The owner's Note 10+ was in the dark theme, where the icons are white and correct. The defect shows only in the light theme.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Fixes: PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/field-notes/pull/256** (branch fix/device-pass-followups, bound to this session).U+000AU+002D c819e86f fix(macos):U+000A  U+002D Adds openingWindowWidth 1200 and openingWindowHeight 800 and an openingFrame().U+000A  U+002D The frame is fitted to the screen's visibleFrame, never below the content minimum, and centred. frameAtLeastMinimum was replaced.U+000A  U+002D test/native/macos_window_min_size_test.dart gained an 'opening size' group, which was red first.U+000AU+002D 06aee682 fix(meadow):U+000A  U+002D The Column gets mainAxisAlignment.center.U+000A  U+002D New test/features/garden/widgets/meadow_focus_stepper_layout_test.dart, red first: 7.5 pt high on the phone and 3.5 on the desktop.U+000A  U+002D The meadow_focus_phone_noon_light golden was updated under America/Edmonton; the before and after images were checked by eye.U+000AU+002D Full suite on the branch: analyze is clean and every folder passes, tooling 106 of 106 included.U+000AU+002D Lab macOS VM: the fixed fresh app opened at 1200x789 at x=120. The height was clamped to the VM's visible screen, and the window was centred. The lavender clears the subtitle by about 30 pt.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Installs refreshed from 06aee682.**U+000AU+002D Mac:U+000A  U+002D ~/Applications/field_notes_plain.app and field_notes_fresh.app were replaced; the 9e41b3ba copies went to the Trash folder.U+000A  U+002D The fresh app's Documents (field_notes.sqlite and media) were moved to the Trash folder, so onboarding runs again. macOS refuses to move a whole container ('Operation not permitted').U+000AU+002D Note 10+: plain and fresh updated with `adb install -r`, keeping their data.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Mac cleanup of old versions** (owner request), 5.3 GB moved to ~/.Trash/field-notes-old-builds-2026-10-03:U+000AU+002D ~/Applications/field_notes_test.app (.manual) and field_notes_v7.app.U+000AU+002D Every folder in testkit/apps, including the probe build the testkit README expects at apps/profile.U+000AU+002D The device-pass bench .app and itest builds, and nbench.apk.U+000AU+002D The repo's build/macos Debug app and build/probe.U+000AU+002D The pkg-upgrade and serene-sutherland worktree Debug apps.U+000AU+002D testkit/work/manual's built .app and .apk.U+000AU+000AKept:U+000AU+002D The two apps in ~/Applications.U+000AU+002D device-pass/apps plain.apk and fresh.apk (9e41b3ba), and mbench.apk and sbench.apk for an identical S24 Ultra run.U+000AU+000AOld test data containers are untouched, pending the owner's answer: axprobe, dmgs, gbench, manual, mbench, nprobe, probe and v7. The real-journal container dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes is never to be touched.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab:** `lab down --all` left nothing behind. The fix-build worktrees were removed; the fix-followups worktree is kept until #256 merges.
